title: Skin Longevity: Taking Cosmetic Testing Beyond Anti-Aging
summary: he shift from anti-aging to skin longevity is changing how cosmetic efficacy is evaluated. New testing approaches can look beyond visible signs of aging to explore the biological mechanisms associated with healthier skin over time
